title: hdf5write
summary: Legacy alias for writing dense HDF5 datasets.

gpu_support.notes: Uses the same host HDF5 path as `h5write`.

description: `hdf5write(filename, dataset, data)` is the legacy compatibility name for `h5write` and supports the same dense write and hyperslab selection subset.
behaviors: Partial writes use native HDF5 hyperslabs.
Sparse, complex, cell, struct, object, and handle values raise deterministic unsupported-type errors.
